problem_statement: A model-authored evidence string can be semantically intended as a source span yet differ by one character from immutable authority. Schema validity cannot make that approximation evidence, and post-hoc fuzzy repair would silently replace model output.
governing_invariants: The factual summary and commentary candidate remain byte-immutable, separately identified sources.
The model may select a span but must never author, normalize, translate, paraphrase, trim, or repair the bytes that constitute evidence.
Candidate span references may resolve only against candidate bytes; authority-support references may resolve only against factual-summary bytes.
Resolution is deterministic and total: a valid reference yields exactly one source slice; an invalid or ambiguous reference fails closed.
Rendered source text is derived evidence and never substituted back into the raw model response.
Semantic classification, source membership, and owner-quality evaluation remain distinct receipts.

recommended_contract.name: COPYLESS_UTF8_HALF_OPEN_SOURCE_REFERENCE

model_emits.source_sha256: prebound immutable source identity selected from an exact finite set

field_role_rules.authority_support_ref: source_role must be FACTUAL_AUTHORITY or the field may be null

deterministic_resolver: Verify the referenced source SHA-256 equals the case-bound source identity.
Require 0 <= start_utf8 < end_utf8 <= source byte length.
Require both offsets to be UTF-8 code-point boundaries and the slice to decode strictly as UTF-8.
Return the exact byte slice and bind its SHA-256, offsets, source role, and source identity in a separate projection receipt.
Reject cross-source roles, empty spans, invalid boundaries, out-of-range offsets, identity drift, and any schema/reference mismatch.
Run existing semantic membership and cross-record reconciliation over resolved bytes; successful projection does not imply semantic correctness.
why_offsets_over_model_copied_text: All non-empty contiguous source spans remain expressible without an O(n-squared) registry embedded in the prompt.
Romanian diacritics and repeated substrings are unambiguous because source identity and byte coordinates are explicit.
The model cannot introduce the observed angajații-to-angazații mutation into evidence bytes.
No nearest-match heuristic or editorial repair is needed.

alternatives_assessed.benefit: Preserves human-readable copied spans in raw output while constraining them to exact source substrings.
alternatives_assessed.boundary: If prototyped later, it must constrain the correct source per field and retain post-generation exact validation.

alternatives_assessed.benefit: Simplest finite constrained choice and inherently exact.
costs: coverage depends on an upstream span enumerator
can accidentally turn extraction policy into semantic routing

alternatives_assessed.reason: It silently repairs model-authored evidence, can select the wrong repeated or semantically different span, and destroys auditability of the actual response.
Case folding, accent folding, whitespace normalization, or spelling tolerance weakens byte-immutable provenance. Normalized forms may be diagnostic metadata only.

receipt_separation.raw_model_receipt: Preserves the exact reference-bearing JSON bytes.
receipt_separation.projection_receipt: Records source identity, role, offsets, exact projected-byte hash, and success/failure reason without rewriting raw output.
receipt_separation.semantic_receipt: Classifies the projected ledger and may still reject unsupported inference, wrong event alignment, incomplete coverage, or bad reconciliation.
receipt_separation.terminal_receipt: Applies fail-closed precedence and preserves every prior phase result.

case01_acceptance_requirements: The exact full candidate commentary can be selected with CANDIDATE source identity and [0, byte_length) without copying its text.
Every resolved candidate or vehicle span must contain immutable angajații bytes; the observed angazații approximation is structurally impossible as projected evidence.
The factual-summary support slice remains independently bound to FACTUAL_AUTHORITY and cannot populate a candidate field.
A projection pass does not cure the ledger's separate semantic concern: its P2 event_alignment marked a governed event as NEW_UNSUPPORTED_EVENT; that remains for owner/evaluator review.
Case 01 execution, Stage C, and any inference remain separately gated.
bounded_future_verification_recommendati: If separately authorized, first define a versioned reference schema and pure resolver only; do not alter the approved evaluator or construct a probe.

Verify the resolver with captured Case 01 bytes and exhaustive small UTF-8 fixtures covering diacritics, repeated text, emoji, combining sequences, JSON escaping, empty/out-of-range/mid-codepoint offsets, wrong source roles, and identity drift.
Property-test that every accepted projection equals exactly source_bytes[start_utf8:end_utf8] and that no rejected reference produces bytes.
Add captured-ledger conversion tests only as non-authoritative fixtures; never mutate the frozen raw ledger.
Stop for owner review before choosing offset references versus an exact-substring decoding projector, before evaluator rebinding, and before any probe.
explicit_non_goals: No repair or reinterpretation of the frozen Case 01 output.
No prompt, schema, grammar, constraint, controller, tracker, runner, evaluator, model, runtime, or Stage C change.
No new inference, retry, other case, curriculum exposure, enrichment, production authority, or training.
